build_AutoencoderKLMochi: build a python module to instantiate an AutoencoderKLMochi VAE model for video latent encoding and decoding
run_AutoencoderKLMochi_encode: run the AutoencoderKLMochi encode method to convert video frames into a diagonal Gaussian latent distribution
run_AutoencoderKLMochi_decode: run the AutoencoderKLMochi decode method to reconstruct video frames from latent representations
enable_AutoencoderKLMochi_tiling: enable tiled VAE decoding on AutoencoderKLMochi to reduce memory usage for large video inputs
run_AutoencoderKLMochi_forward: run the AutoencoderKLMochi forward method to encode and decode a video sample with optional posterior sampling
